completeness.why: All five provider functions now only build their own data (institution, bank key, insert fields) and delegate the whole sequence (upgrade-or-insert with transfer payee, initial syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, sync-event) to linkBankSyncAccount; the preserved inconsistencies are explicit arguments (syncFileId only for Pluggy.ai, mask/official_name via newAccount, eventTables for Akahu).

interface.why: Parameters map one-to-one to the real variations (bank key, sync source, insert fields, optional file id, event tables) with no speculative options, and each preserved inconsistency is visible as an explicit argument at its call site.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies in server/accounts/app.ts are removed, not reshaped; what remains per provider is only its own argument mapping.
